description: This file defines the class Zend_XmlRpc_Server_Fault, which extends Zend_XmlRpc_Fault, encapsulating XML-RPC fault responses and managing fault exceptions and observers within the Zend Framework's XML-RPC server component.

classes.name: Zend_XmlRpc_Server_Fault
classes.description: A class representing XML-RPC server faults, extending Zend_XmlRpc_Fault, with capabilities to attach/detach fault exception classes and observers, and to retrieve the associated exception.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructs a fault object based on an exception, setting fault code and message, and notifying observers.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Returns a new instance of Zend_XmlRpc_Server_Fault for a given exception.

methods.name: attachFaultException
methods.description: Attaches exception classes that can be used to generate XML-RPC faults.

methods.name: detachFaultException
methods.description: Detaches specified exception classes from fault generation.

methods.name: attachObserver
methods.description: Attaches an observer class to monitor fault events.

methods.name: detachObserver
methods.description: Detaches an observer class from fault monitoring.

methods.name: getException
methods.description: Retrieves the exception associated with the fault.
